receipt.equivalence_review: The refusal rests on the fully returned MCU block-to-part-to-package chain rather than the earlier empty block-role filter. Exact original N3 mandates BGA for mcu.32-bit; the only pinned MCU block selects STM32F103C8T6 in LQFP-48. Full pinned-catalog inspection confirms no alternate eligible MCU. UNSATISFIED_SELECTION/functions.mcu replays; no invented parts or package substitution.

refusal.reason: The required mcu.32-bit BGA selection is unavailable in the queried closed-world catalog. The digital.mcu search returns only block:mcu-core, whose U1 selects part:st-stm32f103c8t6. The mcu.32-bit part search returns only that AGENT_VERIFIED part, with package: package:lqfp-48-stm32; the queried package record identifies its family as LQFP-48, not BGA. The BGA package search returns no records. Substituting this LQFP MCU would violate the mandatory BGA requirement.
